caption: The drawing depicts a clear, spherical glass vessel held within a square, open metal frame. The frame consists of four vertical posts, each with a bulged central section, connecting the top and bottom square plates. Both the top and bottom plates are made of metal, primarily dark greenish-blue with patches of reddish-brown corrosion or patina, and display decorative perforations and patterns. The top plate features a metal loop or handle at its center, above the opening of the glass vessel. The glass sphere is transparent with a reflective surface, showing light reflections and shadows, and is held in place by the metal frame without any visible attachments. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's signature, "Rose Campbell Geike," is written in small, neat letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Ballot Box
